claims.text: Oropharyngeal or airway angioedema: subcutaneous epinephrine 0.3 mL of 1:1000 solution and hospital admission; on discharge, supply and teach an epinephrine autoinjector
claims.quote: Patients who have angioedema involving the oropharynx or any involvement of the airway should receive subcutaneous epinephrine 0.3 mL of 1:1000 solution and be admitted to the hospital. On discharge, patients should be supplied with and trained in the use of an auto-injectable epinephrine pen.
